crossRefs.note: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and while…
Therefore their way will be to them as slippery places in the darkness. They will be driven on, and fall therein; for I…

translations.web: Let their way be dark and slippery, Yahweh’s angel pursuing them.
translations.bsb: May their path be dark and slick, as the angel of the LORD pursues.
translations.kjv: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute
translations.asv: Let their way be dark and slippery, And the angel of Jehovah pursuing them.
